正統十三年進士登科錄

玉音

正統十三年二月十三日早，禮部尚書臣胡濙等官於奉天門奏：「為科舉事，會試天下舉人，取中一百五十名。本年三月十五日殿試，合請讀卷及執事等官吏部尚書王直等四十三員。其進士出身等第，恭依太祖高皇帝欽定資格：第一甲例取三名，第一名從六品，第二、第三名正七品，賜進士及第；第二甲從七品，賜進士出身；第三甲正八品，賜同進士出身。」奉聖旨：「是。欽此。」

讀卷官
資政大夫、吏部尚書王直〔甲申進士〕
資德大夫、正治上卿、戶部尚書王佐〔辛卯貢士〕
資善大夫、兵部尚書鄺埜〔辛卯進士〕
translation_en:
Record of the Metropolitan Graduates of the Thirteenth Year of the Zhengtong Reign (1448)

Imperial Rescript

Early in the morning on the thirteenth day of the second month of the thirteenth year of the Zhengtong reign, Your Servant Hu Ying 胡濙, Minister of Rites, and other officials submitted a memorial at the Fengtian Gate: "Concerning the civil service examinations, in the Metropolitan Examination of provincial graduates (juren) from across the empire, one hundred and fifty men have been selected as successful candidates. For the Palace Examination on the fifteenth day of the third month of this year, it is fitting to request the appointment of forty-three Exam-Reading Officials and Administrative Functionaries, headed by Wang Zhi 王直, Minister of Personnel. Regarding the ranks and classifications for the appointment of metropolitan graduates (jinshi), we respectfully follow the qualifications imperially established by Emperor Gao, the Grand Progenitor (Taizu): in the First Class (diyijia), three men are selected by precedent, the first-place graduate being accorded rank 6b, and the second- and third-place graduates rank 7a, all conferred the title Metropolitan Graduate with Honors (jinshi jidi); those in the Second Class (dierjia) are accorded rank 7b and conferred the title Metropolitan Graduate (jinshi chushen); and those in the Third Class (disanjia) are accorded rank 8a and conferred the title Associate Metropolitan Graduate (tong jinshi chushen)."

We received the Imperial Edict: "Approved. Respect this."

Exam-Reading Officials (dujuan guan):

Wang Zhi 王直, Grandee for Aid in Governance (zizheng dafu) and Minister of Personnel (libu shangshu) [metropolitan graduate of the jiashen year (1404)].
Wang Zuo 王佐, Grandee for Virtuous Aid (zide dafu), Senior Lord for Rectifying Governance (zhengzhi shangqing), and Minister of Revenue (hubu shangshu) [tribute scholar (gongshi) of the xinmao year (1411)].
Kuang Ye 鄺埜, Grandee for Excellence in Aid (zishan dafu) and Minister of War (bingbu shangshu) [metropolitan graduate of the xinmao year (1411)].

正統十三年三月十五日早，諸貢士赴內府殿試，上御奉天殿，親賜策問。

三月十七日早，文武百官朝服侍班。是日，錦衣衛設鹵簿于丹陛、丹墀內，上御奉天殿，鴻臚寺官傳制唱名。禮部官捧黃榜，鼓樂導引，出長安左門外張掛畢，順天府官用傘蓋、儀從送狀元□□□
translation_en:
Sequence of Imperial Honors (Enrong cidi)

In the thirteenth year of the Zhengtong reign (1448), early in the morning of the fifteenth day of the third month, all Tribute Scholars (gongshi) proceeded to the Inner Palace for the Palace Examination. His Majesty ascended the Hall of Revering Heaven (Fengtian dian) and personally bestowed the policy question.

Early in the morning of the seventeenth day of the third month, all civil and military officials stood in attendance in court dress. On this day, the Embroidered-Uniform Guard (Jinyi wei) set out the Imperial Procession Guard (lubu) upon the Vermilion Steps and within the Vermilion Courtyard. His Majesty ascended the Hall of Revering Heaven, and officials of the Court of State Ceremonial (Honglu si) transmitted the imperial decree and called out the names of the graduates (changming). Officials of the Ministry of Rites (Libu) carried the yellow placard, led by drums and music, out past the Left Chang'an Gate and posted it on display. Once this was completed, officials of Shuntian Prefecture used parasols and ceremonial attendants to escort the Principal Graduate (zhuangyuan) [to his residence?] …

Yue Zheng 岳正 [registered in the military officer category in Huo County, Tongzhou Subprefecture, Shuntian Prefecture; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); style name Jifang 季方; third in generational seniority; aged thirty-one, born on the ninth day of the tenth month]. He is married to née Song. He placed sixty-fifth in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and first in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Second Class (Erjia), fifty men, conferred the status of Metropolitan Graduate (Jinshi chushen):

Wan An 萬安, registered under a military household in Meizhou 眉州, Sichuan, was a student of the Directorate of Education (Guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing). His courtesy name is Xunji 循吉; he is the second in his generation-order and is thirty-one sui, born on the twentieth day of the first month. His great-grandfather was Wan Zhongyi 重懿, his grandfather was Wan Purong 溥榮, his father was Wan Lin 琳, and his mother was née Zhou 周氏. Both his parents are deceased (yonggan xia). His elder brother is Wan Zifu 子富, and his younger brother is Wan Zishi 子實. He is married to née Hu 胡氏. He placed ninth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Cao Ding 曹鼎, registered under a military household in Ningjin County 寧晉縣, Zhaozhou 趙州, Zhending Prefecture 真定府, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili), was a County School Student (xianxue sheng) specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji). His courtesy name is Wanyi 萬鎰; he is the fourth in his generation-order and is twenty-six sui, born on the second day of the first month. His great-grandfather was Cao Kerou 克柔; his grandfather was Cao Tingxun 庭訓 (posthumously honoured as Left Vice Minister of Personnel concurrently Academician of the Hanlin Academy); his father was Cao Zhi 祉 (posthumously honoured as Left Vice Minister of Personnel concurrently Academician of the Hanlin Academy); his father's former wives were née Meng 孟氏 (posthumously honoured as Lady of Virtue, Shuren) and née Xue 薛氏 (posthumously honoured as Lady of Virtue); and his mother is née Wu 吳氏 (invested as Dowager Lady of Virtue, Tai Shuren). His mother is living while his father is deceased (cishi xia). His elder brothers are Cao Ding 鼎 [?], Cao Nai 鼐 (Left Vice Minister of Personnel concurrently Academician of the Hanlin Academy), and Cao Zi 䵺, and his younger brother is Cao Zi 鼒. He is married to née Han 韓氏. He placed sixty-fourth in the Shuntian Prefecture 順天府 Provincial Examination and sixty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Mao Yu 毛玉, registered under an official household in Wujin County 武進縣, Changzhou Prefecture 常州府, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili), was a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing). His courtesy name is Liangqi 良器; he is the first in his generation-order and is twenty-nine sui, born on the twenty-ninth day of the fifth month. His great-grandfather was Mao Zhongqian 仲謙 (Vice Prefect of Shaowu Prefecture 邵武府, Fujian), his grandfather was Mao Boshi 伯時, his father was Mao Jing 靖 (Prefectural Instructor in the Prefectural Yin-Yang School), and his mother is née Ye 葉氏. His mother is living while his father is deceased (cishi xia). His paternal uncle is Mao Shi 峕 (District Magistrate of Anji County 安吉縣), his younger brother is Mao Cheng 珵, and his younger paternal cousins are Mao Xuan 瑄, Mao Lin 琳, Mao Sui 璲, and Mao Jue 珏. He is married to née Gao 高氏. He placed twentieth in the Yingtian Prefecture 應天府 Provincial Examination and forty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Xu Pu 徐溥 [native of Shaowu County 邵武縣, Shaowu Prefecture 邵武府, Fujian 福建, of military registration; National University Student (guozisheng); specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Shihong 仕弘; second in seniority among brothers; aged forty, born on the sixteenth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Daqing 達卿, his grandfather was Yongheng 永亨, his father was Youcheng 友誠, and his mother is Madam Zhang 章氏. His mother is living while his father is deceased. His elder brother is Shijing 仕敬, and he is married to Madam Huang 黃氏. He ranked fifty-ninth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and ninety-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Huang Pu 黃溥 [native of Yiyang County 弋陽縣, Guangxin Prefecture 廣信府, Jiangxi 江西, of civilian registration; National University Student; specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Chengji 澄濟; third in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-eight, born on the ninth day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Qianfu 謙甫; his grandfather was Youzhong 祐忠 [Registrar of Yanping Prefecture 延平府, Fujian]; his father was Jingrang 敬讓; his mother was Madam Chen 陳氏; and his stepmother is Madam Zhang 張氏. His stepmother is living while his father is deceased. His younger brothers are Zhe 哲, Ding 定, Chang 昌, Ji 繼, Hua 華, Duan 端, Ke 恪, Yong 永, and Kai 楷; he is married to Madam Zhou 周氏. He ranked twenty-eighth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and twenty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Weng Shiyong 翁世用 [native of Putian County 莆田縣, Xinghua Prefecture 興化府, Fujian, of Confucian-scholar registration; Added Student (zengguangsheng) of the Prefectural School; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Shiyong 世用; second in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-seven, born on the seventeenth day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Daoyuan 道源; his grandfather was Shining 仕寧; his father is Ying 瑛 [Examining Editor in the Hanlin Academy]; his mother was Madam Zhou 周氏; and his stepmother was Madam Wang 王氏. His father is living while his mother and stepmother are deceased. His elder brother is Wenxian 文賢; his younger brothers are Shizi 世資 [Secretary in the Ministry of Revenue], Yue 嶽, Cen 岑, Cheng 澄, Yin 銀, and Duo 鐸; he is married to Madam Chen 陳氏. He ranked sixth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and seventy-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Hu Hao 胡皞 [native of Anfu County 安福縣, Ji'an Prefecture 吉安府, Jiangxi, of civilian registration; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Lexi 樂熈; fourth in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-eight, born on the first day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Guanwo 觀我, his grandfather was Wenchu 文初, his father is Qixian 齊先, and his mother is Madam Li 李氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Leyou 樂友; his younger brothers are Lezhi 樂智, Qian 潜, and Yi 沂; he is married to Madam Yan 嚴氏. He ranked twenty-second in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

His great-grandfather was Youshan, his grandfather was Zhen, his father is Kequan, his father's former wife was née Zou, and his mother is née Pan. Both parents are living; his elder brothers are Min, Chang, Jin [District Magistrate of Anxiang County], Zheng, and Qi, and he is married to née Xue. He placed forty-sixth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and thirty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Jingxing 劉景星 [registered in Houguan County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Fujian, under civilian registration; an added student (zengguangsheng) of the county Confucian school specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Jingsheng, tenth in seniority among his generation's brothers, aged twenty-six, born on the sixteenth day of the fourth month]. His great-grandfather was Bao, his grandfather is Zhi, his father is Yonggang [Instructor in the Confucian school of Fuliang County], his mother was née Chen, and his stepmother is née Lin. Both his grandparents and parents are living; his elder brother is Jingzheng [Instructor in the Confucian school of Ganyu County], his younger brothers are Jingchang, Jingjing, and Jingmian, and he is married to née Lin. He placed thirteenth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and one hundred forty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhou Hu 周瑚 [registered in Anfu County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi, under civilian registration; an added student of the prefectural Confucian school specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Gongqi, first in seniority among his generation's brothers, aged thirty-seven, born on the twenty-second day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Hanzhang, his grandfather was Yunyu, his father is Shuzhan, and his mother is née Peng. Both parents are living; his younger brothers are Sheng and Hao, and he is married to née Liu. He placed seventeenth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and ninety-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xing You 邢宥 [registered in Wenchang County, Qiongzhou Prefecture, Guangdong, under civilian registration; a student of the county Confucian school specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Kekuan, first in seniority among his generation's brothers, aged thirty-three, born on the nineteenth day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Tingyu, his grandfather was Shixian, his father is Wenguang, his mother was née Xu, and his stepmother is née Guo. Both his father and stepmother are living; his younger brothers are Ding, Xuan, Yi, and Cheng, and he is married to née Lin. He placed forty-second in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and one hundred thirtieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

His great-grandfather was Wang Yinqing 隱卿; his grandfather was Wang Sijing 思敬; his father was Wang Ruwei 汝為 (Instructor in the Chizhou Prefectural School 池州府學教授); and his mother was Lady Huang 黃氏. Both of his parents are living (juqing xia). His younger brothers are Wang Dalun 大綸, Wang Dagang 大綱, and Wang Daji 大紀. He married Lady Li 黎氏. He placed fifth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and fortieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Rulin 王汝霖: Registered in an official household in Kunshan County 崑山縣, Suzhou Prefecture 蘇州府, Direct-attached (Zhili 直隸); a prefectural student; specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Minwang 民望; fifth in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-six, born on the fifteenth day of the eleventh month. His great-grandfather [unrecorded]; grandfather [unrecorded]; father [unrecorded]; mother [unrecorded]. Parental status: [unrecorded] xia. He placed fifth in the Shuntian Prefecture 順天府 Provincial Examination and seventieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Kang Gui 康圭: Registered in a civilian household in Taihe County 泰和縣, Ji'an Prefecture 吉安府, Jiangxi; a student in the Directorate of Education (guozisheng); specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Erxi 爾錫; first in seniority among brothers; aged forty-six, born on the fourth day of the fourth month. His great-grandfather was Kang Wendou 文畣 [?]; his grandfather was Kang Cuncheng 存誠; his father was Kang Shounan 壽南; and his mother was Lady Zhong 鍾氏. Both of his parents are deceased (yonggan xia). His younger brothers are Kang Erjun 爾俊 and Kang Erxian 爾咸. He married Lady Ouyang 歐陽氏. He placed seventh in the Yingtian Prefecture 應天府 Provincial Examination and 146th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhu Xu 朱序 (registered in a civilian household of Qingjiang County, Linjiang Prefecture, Jiangxi; a Student of the Directorate of Imperial Academy specializing in the Record of Rites [Liji]; courtesy name Yizai; seniority 1; aged forty, born on the twenty-first day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Zhu Chuwang; his grandfather was Zhu Shunchuan (Law Secretary in the Fujian Regional Military Commission); his father was Zhu Zhongjie; and his mother is née Wang. His mother is living (his father is deceased). He is married to née He. He placed 20th in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 135th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yang Yi 楊宜 (registered in a civilian household of She County, Huizhou Prefecture, Zhili; an Added Student of the prefectural school specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals [Chunqiu]; courtesy name Yanli; seniority 2; aged forty-five, born on the thirteenth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Yang Xinren; his grandfather was Yang Yuan (posthumously honored as Right Vice Minister of Justice); his father was Yang Sheng (Instructor, posthumously honored as Right Vice Minister of Justice); and his mother was née Yuan (invested as Dowager Lady of Virtue). Both of his parents are deceased. His elder brother is Yang Ning (Right Vice Minister of Justice), and his younger brothers are Yang Xian and Yang Cha. He is married to née Yu. He placed 22nd in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 127th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Gui Yi 桂怡 (registered in a civilian household of Cixi County, Ningbo Prefecture, Zhejiang; a Student of the Directorate of Imperial Academy specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Tingyan; seniority 23; aged forty, born on the thirteenth day of the first month [or aged forty-one, missing month?]). His great-grandfather was Gui Qixian (Subordinate Registrar of a School under the Yuan dynasty); his grandfather was Gui Mengqi; his father is Gui Zongguang; and his mother was née Qiu. His father is living (his mother is deceased). His elder brothers are Gui Gong and Gui Xun, and his younger brother is Gui Ci. He is married to née Chen. He placed 39th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 86th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Zhu 劉洙 (registered in a civilian household of Guixi County, Guangxin Prefecture, Jiangxi; a county school student specializing in the Classic of History [Shujing]; courtesy name Dongzhou; seniority 21; aged twenty-eight, born on the second day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Liu Boqian; his grandfather was Liu Mengfang; his father is Liu Yuhong (Instructor of the Suzhou Prefectural School); his legal mother is née Zhou; and his birth mother is née Zou. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Liu Wen, and his younger brothers are Liu Si, Liu Jing, and Liu Chao. He is married to née Jiang. He placed 1st in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 74th in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Liu Ji 劉吉 (courtesy name Youzhi 祐之, second in seniority in his generation) was registered under a military household in Boye County 博野縣, Baoding Prefecture 保定府, in the Metropolitan Area 直隸. A Confucian scholar (rushi) specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji), he was twenty-two sui old, born on the first day of the eighth month. His great-grandfather was Liu Shaoxian 紹先, his grandfather was Liu Jie 潔, his father was Liu Fu 輔, and his mother was née Qi 齊氏. Both his parents and grandparents were living (chongqing xia). He had an elder brother, Qing 慶, and younger brothers, Ning 寧, Tai 泰, and Heng 亨, and was betrothed to a woman née Duan 段氏. He placed ninety-third in the Shuntian Prefecture 順天府 Provincial Examination and fifty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

He Sheng 何陞 (courtesy name Wenda 文達, first in seniority in his generation) was registered under a civilian household in Chun'an County 淳安縣, Yanzhou Prefecture 嚴州府, Zhejiang 浙江. A National University Student (guozi sheng) specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing), he was thirty-seven sui old, born on the first day of the fourth month. His great-grandfather was He Zhongzhen 仲禎, his grandfather was He Rongshan 榮善 (who served as a Department Magistrate), his father was He Gongyu 公郁, and his mother was née Lu 盧氏. His mother was living while his father was deceased (cishi xia). He had a younger brother, Wenheng 文衡, and was married to a woman née Wang 王氏. He placed forty-fifth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and thirty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

He Yi 何宜 (courtesy name Xingyi 行義, first in seniority in his generation) was registered under a military household in Fuqing County 福清縣, Fuzhou Prefecture 福州府, Fujian 福建. A Supplementary Student (zengguang sheng) of the county Confucian school specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing), he was twenty sui old, born on the twelfth day of the twelfth month. His great-grandfather was He Luan 鑾, his grandfather was He Yu 昱, his father was He Yan 演, and his mother was née Shi 施氏. Both of his parents were living (juqing xia). He had a younger brother, Zhi 寘, and was married to a woman née Lin 林氏. He placed nineteenth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ni Jing 倪敬 (courtesy name Rujing 汝敬, first in seniority in his generation) was registered under a civilian household in Wuxi County 無錫縣, Changzhou Prefecture 常州府, in the Metropolitan Area 直隸. A National University Student (guozi sheng) specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing), he was thirty-three sui old, born on the twenty-fifth day of the fourth month. His great-grandfather was Ni Wensi 文斯, his grandfather was Ni Jun 峻 (Chief Supervising Secretary of the Office of Scrutiny for War), his father was Ni Zhongyuan 仲淵, and his mother was née Meng 孟氏. His mother was living while his father was deceased (cishi xia). He was married to a woman née Peng 彭氏. He placed eleventh in the Yingtian Prefecture 應天府 Provincial Examination and twenty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

張聰，貫山西太原府陽曲縣，軍籍，國子生，治《書經》，字士敏，行三，年二十八，三月二十日生。曾祖思恭，祖佐〔安肅縣知縣〕，父鎬〔肇慶府稅課司大使〕，母范氏。具慶下。兄康敏、康莊，弟康民、康寧。娶許氏。山西鄉試第二十七名，會試第一百三名。
沈義，貫武成後衛，官籍，直隸江都縣人，順天府學武生，治《書經》，字時宜，行一，年二十五，二月二十二日生。曾祖士名〔元萬戶，贈武成後衛指揮同知〕，祖諒〔武成後衛指揮同知〕，父文，母温氏。重慶下。叔英〔武成後衛指揮同知〕，弟禮、璿、璣。娶孟氏。順天府鄉試第十二名，會試第九十七名。
translation_en:
Zhou Ying 周瑛, registered in a military household of Putian County 莆田縣, Xinghua Prefecture 興化府, Fujian 福建, specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing). His courtesy name is Tingcan 廷參, he is first in seniority among his brothers, and he is twenty-eight sui, born on the eleventh day of the ninth month. His great-grandfather was Heshu 和叔, his grandfather was Yaoci 堯慈, his father is Yanyou 彥由, and his mother is née Weng 翁氏. Both parents are living. His younger brothers are Qi 玘, Ying 瑛 [?], Ying 瑛 [?], Xuan 瑄, Lin 琳, Jue 玨, Wan 琬, Jiu 玖, and Gan 玕. He married née Ou 歐氏. He placed twentieth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 141st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Sun Mao 孫茂, registered in a civilian household of Anyue County 安岳縣, Tongchuan Subprefecture 潼川州, Sichuan 四川, is a Directorate Student (guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing). His courtesy name is Tinglan 庭蘭, he is first in seniority among his brothers, and he is twenty-eight sui, born on the second day of the tenth month. His great-grandfather was Wenzhi 文質, his grandfather is Lu 禄, his father is Jiawen 嘉聞, and his mother is née Zou 鄒氏. Both parents and grandparents are living. He married née Luo 羅氏. He placed twenty-second in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and twentieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Cong 張聰, registered in a military household of Yangqu County 陽曲縣, Taiyuan Prefecture 太原府, Shanxi 山西, is a Directorate Student (guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing). His courtesy name is Shimin 士敏, he is third in seniority among his brothers, and he is twenty-eight sui, born on the twentieth day of the third month. His great-grandfather was Sigong 思恭, his grandfather was Zuo 佐 (District Magistrate of Ansu County 安肅縣), his father is Hao 鎬 (Commissioner-in-chief of the Commercial Tax Office of Zhaoqing Prefecture 肇慶府), and his mother is née Fan 范氏. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Kangmin 康敏 and Kangzhuang 康莊, and his younger brothers are Kangmin 康民 and Kangning 康寧. He married née Xu 許氏. He placed twenty-seventh in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and 103rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shen Yi 沈義, registered in an official household of the Wucheng Rear Guard 武成後衛 and originally from Jiangdu County 江都縣 in the Metropolitan Area (Zhili 直隸), is a military student [?] at the Shuntian Prefectural School 順天府學 specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing). His courtesy name is Shiyi 時宜, he is first in seniority among his brothers, and he is twenty-five sui, born on the twenty-second day of the second month. His great-grandfather was Shiming 士名 (Myriarch in the Yuan dynasty, posthumously appointed Vice Commander of the Wucheng Rear Guard), his grandfather is Liang 諒 (Vice Commander of the Wucheng Rear Guard), his father is Wen 文, and his mother is née Wen 温氏. Both parents and grandparents are living. His paternal uncle is Ying 英 (Vice Commander of the Wucheng Rear Guard), and his younger brothers are Li 禮, Xuan 璿, and Ji 璣. He married née Meng 孟氏. He placed twelfth in the Shuntian 順天府 Provincial Examination and ninety-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

punctuated:
鄭顯〔貫浙江台州府臨海縣民籍，縣學生，治《禮記》，字廷謨，行二，年二十四，十一月十五日生〕。曾祖希文，祖世直，父登壽，母范氏。慈侍下，兄顥，弟賓，娶陳氏。浙江鄉試第四十四名，會試第一百八名。
劉珝〔貫山東青州府壽光縣軍籍，國子生，治《書經》，字叔溫，行三，年二十三，五月二十五日生〕。曾祖讓，祖良佐，伯甄〔四川道監察御史〕，父昺，母李氏。具慶下，兄環、球，弟璇、璣、玥，娶張氏。山東鄉試第二十七名，會試第二十五名。
吳禮〔貫直隸常州府武進縣民籍，國子生，治《書經》，字貴和，行一，年三十八，四月十八日生〕。曾祖文卿，祖子華，父士誠，母花氏，繼母蔣氏。具慶下，弟祺、禋，娶司氏，繼娶李氏。應天府鄉試第六名，會試第一百七名。
李蕃〔貫雲南澂江府河陽縣民籍，府學生，治《易經》，字廷茂，行二，年二十六，七月十八日生〕。曾祖俊，祖惟孝，父添祐，母田氏。具慶下，兄嵎，弟蓁，娶張氏。雲南鄉試第一名，會試第一百名。
translation_en:
Zheng Xian 鄭顯 [registered in a civilian household of Linhai County 臨海縣, Taizhou Prefecture 台州府, Zhejiang 浙江; a county school student specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Tingmo 廷謨; second in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-four, born on the fifteenth day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Zheng Xiwen 希文, his grandfather was Zheng Shizhi 世直, his father was Zheng Dengshou 登壽, and his mother is née Fan 范. His mother is living; he has an elder brother, Zheng Hao 顥, and a younger brother, Zheng Bin 賓; and he is married to Lady Chen 陳. He placed forty-fourth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Xu 劉珝 [registered in a military household of Shouguang County 壽光縣, Qingzhou Prefecture 青州府, Shandong 山東; a student of the Directorate of Education (Guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Shuwen 叔溫; third in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-three, born on the twenty-fifth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Liu Rang 讓; his grandfather was Liu Liangzuo 良佐; his paternal elder uncle was Liu Zhen 甄 [Investigating Censor of the Sichuan Circuit]; his father is Liu Bing 昺; and his mother is née Li 李. Both of his parents are living; he has elder brothers Liu Huan 環 and Liu Qiu 球, and younger brothers Liu Xuan 璇, Liu Ji 璣, and Liu Yue 玥; and he is married to Lady Zhang 張. He placed twenty-seventh in the Shandong Provincial Examination and twenty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wu Li 吳禮 [registered in a civilian household of Wujin County 武進縣, Changzhou Prefecture 常州府, Zhili 直隸; a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Guihe 貴和; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-eight, born on the eighteenth day of the fourth month]. His great-grandfather was Wu Wenqing 文卿, his grandfather was Wu Zihua 子華, his father is Wu Shicheng 士誠, his mother was née Hua 花, and his stepmother is née Jiang 蔣. Both his father and stepmother are living; he has younger brothers Wu Qi 祺 and Wu Yin 禋; and he was first married to Lady Si 司 and subsequently married to Lady Li 李. He placed sixth in the Yingtian Prefecture 應天府 Provincial Examination and one hundred seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Fan 李蕃 [registered in a civilian household of Heyang County 河陽縣, Chengjiang Prefecture 澂江府, Yunnan 雲南; a prefectural school student specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Tingmao 廷茂; second in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-six, born on the eighteenth day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Li Jun 俊, his grandfather was Li Weixiao 惟孝, his father is Li Tianyou 添祐, and his mother is née Tian 田. Both of his parents are living; he has an elder brother, Li Yu 嵎, and a younger brother, Li Zhen 蓁; and he is married to Lady Zhang 張. He placed first in the Yunnan Provincial Examination and one hundredth in the Metropolitan Examination.

王勤〔貫直隸真定府武邑縣軍籍，縣學生，治《詩經》，字而勉，行一，年二十九，六月十七日生〕。曾祖士貞，祖斌〔濟陽縣知縣〕，父循〔阜城縣學訓導〕，母呂氏。重慶下。娶沈氏。順天府鄉試第七十一名，會試第五十九名。

translation_en:
Shen Cong 沈琮 (registered under official status in the Standard-Bearer Guard of Nanjing, originally from Wujin County in the Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; a Directorate Student specializing in the Classic of Changes [Yijing]; courtesy name Tingqi; fourth in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-nine, born on the twenty-seventh day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Shen Fu; his grandfather was Shen Yong (Platoon Commander in the Standard-Bearer Guard); his father is Shen Wang; his mother was née Wan, and his stepmothers are née Yuan and née Wang. Both his grandparents and parents are living. His elder brothers are Shen Xuan and Shen Ying; his younger brothers are Shen Yu, Shen Lin, Shen Heng, Shen Si [?], Shen Jin, Shen Huan, and Shen Cheng. He married née Tan. He placed eighth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and thirty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Huixian 汪回顯 (registered under military status in Qimen County, Huizhou Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; a Directorate Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals [Chunqiu]; courtesy name Ruguang; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-eight, born on the second day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Wang Boyang; his grandfather was Wang Xianshao; his father is Wang Minzheng; and his mother is née Ni. Both his parents are living. His younger brothers are Wang Wenxian and Wang Chongxian. He married née Jiang. He placed seventy-first in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and fiftieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Qin 王勤 (registered under military status in Wuyi County, Zhending Prefecture, Northern Metropolitan Area [Zhili]; a County Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Ermian; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-nine, born on the seventeenth day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Wang Shizhen; his grandfather is Wang Bin (Magistrate of Jiyang County); his father is Wang Xun (Assistant Instructor in the Confucian School of Fucheng County); and his mother is née Lü. Both his grandparents and parents are living. He married née Shen. He placed seventy-first in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and fifty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xie Chang 謝昶 (registered under civilian status in Huanggang County, Huangzhou Prefecture, Huguang; an Added Student in the Prefectural School specializing in the Classic of Poetry [Shijing]; courtesy name Boming; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-seven, born on the twentieth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Xie Xinqin; his grandfather was Xie Zhishan; his father is Xie Yezhe [?] (Assistant Magistrate of Changyuan County); and his mother is née Cheng. Both his parents are living. His younger brothers are Xie Ang, Xie Jing, Xie Gui, and Xie Yu. He married née Ding. He placed twenty-fifth in the Huguang Provincial Examination and fifty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

曾祖安甫　祖時佩〔贈廣平府通判〕　父亨〔任四川漢州知州〕　嫡母高氏〔封安人〕　生母李氏

punctuated:
謝瓌〔貫海州千戶所軍籍，國子生，治《書經》，字良珍，行三，年三十二，正月初六日生〕。曾祖本初；祖友春；父宗德；嫡母劉氏，生母唐氏。具慶下。兄琦、瑄，弟琰、瑛。娶楊氏。應天府鄉試第九十五名，會試第四十二名。

黃譽〔貫福建興化府莆田縣民籍，縣學增廣生，治《書經》，字廷永，行二，年三十四，十一月十五日生〕。曾祖靜軒；祖則誠；父德敷；母羅氏，繼母宋氏。慈侍下。兄諭，弟諒、謹、詢。娶鄭氏，繼室林氏。福建鄉試第一名，會試第十四名。

譚廣〔貫江西南康府都昌縣民籍，國子生，治《書經》，字克寬，行三，年四十一，七月初四日生〕。曾祖崇善；祖伯高；父士良；母譚氏。具慶下。兄海、淳。娶石氏。應天府鄉試第十四名，會試第八十七名。

白行順〔貫陝西延安府綏德州清澗縣民籍，國子生，治《春秋》，字致和，行三，年二十八，八月十六日生〕。曾祖安甫；祖時胤〔贈廣平府通判〕；父亨〔任四川漢州知州〕；嫡母高氏〔封安人〕，生母李氏。具慶下。兄行遠、行健，從兄瓊〔國子生〕，弟行中〔甲子貢士〕。娶張氏。陝西鄉試第四名，會試第一百十三名。
translation_en:
Xie Gui 謝瓌 [native of Haizhou Battalion, of military registration; National University Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Liangzhen; third in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-two, born on the sixth day of the first lunar month]. His great-grandfather was Xie Benchu; his grandfather was Xie Youchun; his father is Xie Zongde; his legal mother is née Liu, and his birth mother is née Tang. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Xie Qi and Xie Xuan, and his younger brothers are Xie Yan and Xie Ying. He is married to née Yang. He placed ninety-fifth in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and forty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Huang Yu 黃譽 [native of Putian County, Xinghua Prefecture, Fujian, of civilian registration; Added Student of the County School specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Tingyong; second in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-four, born on the fifteenth day of the eleventh lunar month]. His great-grandfather was Huang Jingxuan; his grandfather was Huang Zecheng; his father was Huang Defu; his mother was née Luo, and his stepmother is née Song. His mother (stepmother) is living. His elder brother is Huang Yu, and his younger brothers are Huang Liang, Huang Jin, and Huang Xun. He was married to née Zheng, and his second wife is née Lin. He placed first in the Fujian Provincial Examination and fourteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Tan Guang 譚廣 [native of Duchang County, Nankang Prefecture, Jiangxi, of civilian registration; National University Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Kekuan; third in seniority among his brothers; aged forty-one, born on the fourth day of the seventh lunar month]. His great-grandfather was Tan Chongshan; his grandfather was Tan Bogao; his father is Tan Shiliang; his mother is née Tan. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Tan Hai and Tan Chun. He is married to née Shi. He placed fourteenth in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and eighty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Bai Xingshun 白行順 [native of Qingjian County, Suide Subprefecture, Yan'an Prefecture, Shaanxi, of civilian registration; National University Student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Zhihe; third in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-eight, born on the sixteenth day of the eighth lunar month]. His great-grandfather was Bai Anfu; his grandfather was Bai Shiyin [posthumously honored as Assistant Prefect of Guangping Prefecture]; his father is Bai Heng [serving as Subprefectural Magistrate of Hanzhou in Sichuan]; his legal mother is née Gao [invested as Mistress of Peace (anren)], and his birth mother is née Li. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Bai Xingyuan and Bai Xingjian, his elder paternal cousin is Bai Qiong [National University Student], and his younger brother is Bai Xingzhong [Tribute Scholar (provincial graduate) of the jiazi year (1444)]. He is married to née Zhang. He placed fourth in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and one hundred and thirteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

宋弼〔貫山西大同府蔚州民籍，州學生，治《書經》，字良輔，行二，年三十三，四月二十二日生〕。曾祖思賢；祖文友；父玉；生母張氏，繼母趙氏。具慶下。兄得；弟寬、弘、海。娶馬氏，繼齊氏。山西鄉試第三十八名，會試第八十二名。
沈敬〔貫浙江杭州前衛軍籍，錢塘縣學武生，治《春秋》，字克欽，行一，年二十五，正月十六日生〕。曾祖名遠；祖彦和；父廷玉；母謝氏。具慶下。娶曹氏。浙江鄉試第十六名，會試第九十九名。
translation_en:
Li Ying 李英, courtesy name Shangxian 尚賢, first in seniority among his brothers, was born on the twenty-fourth day of the first month, and is twenty-nine years old; he is registered in a civilian household of He Subprefecture, Chongqing Prefecture, Sichuan, and is a National University Student specializing in the Book of Documents (Shujing). His great-grandfather was Li Zonggui; his grandfather was Li Gan, Judicial Secretary of the Huguang Provincial Administration Commission; his father is Li Tianfu, and his mother is née Jia, both parents being alive; his younger brothers are Li Qi, Li Jing, Li Zhen, Li Xiang, Li Chen, and Li Huan, and he married a woman née Lan. He placed twenty-seventh in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Song Bi 宋弼, courtesy name Liangfu 良輔, second in seniority among his brothers, was born on the twenty-second day of the fourth month, and is thirty-three years old; he is registered in a civilian household of Yu Subprefecture, Datong Prefecture, Shanxi, and is a Subprefectural Student specializing in the Book of Documents (Shujing). His great-grandfather was Song Sixian; his grandfather was Song Wenyou; his father is Song Yu, his birth mother was née Zhang, and his stepmother is née Zhao, both father and stepmother being alive; his elder brother is Song De, his younger brothers are Song Kuan, Song Hong, and Song Hai, and he married a woman née Ma and subsequently a second wife née Qi. He placed thirty-eighth in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and eighty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shen Jing 沈敬, courtesy name Keqin 克欽, first in seniority among his brothers, was born on the sixteenth day of the first month, and is twenty-five years old; he is registered in a military household of the Hangzhou Front Guard in Zhejiang, and is a Military Student [?] of the Qiantang County School specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu). His great-grandfather was Shen Mingyuan; his grandfather was Shen Yanhe; his father is Shen Tingyu, and his mother is née Xie, both parents being alive; he married a woman née Cao. He placed sixteenth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and ninety-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

蔣敷〔貫應天府江寧縣醫籍，太醫院醫生，治《禮記》，字宗德，行一，年三十，正月初六日生〕。曾祖義甫；祖子中；父彥升〔太醫院御醫〕；母周氏。慈侍下。弟敞、叙。娶史氏。順天府鄉試第三十一名，會試第十七名。

徐珉〔貫浙江衢州府開化縣民籍，縣學生，治《易經》，字廷玉，行二，年二十八，八月十八日生〕。曾祖原實；祖應和〔福建沙縣縣丞〕；父文煥；母姜氏。具慶下。叔文輝〔戊午貢士〕；兄逵；弟〔從弟璽〕津、瑛、雄。娶吾氏。浙江鄉試第十三名，會試第五十七名。
translation_en:
Third Class, 97th-ranked Candidates; Conferred the Status of Associate Metropolitan Graduate.

Gao Chong 高崇 (registered in Jinxiang County, Yanzhou Prefecture, Shandong, under a civilian household registration; a student of the county school specializing in the Book of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Weizhi, first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-eight, born on the sixth day of the third month). His great-grandfather was Gao Boju (Route Commander of Dongping Route under the Yuan); his grandfather was Gao Zhu; his father is Gao Ying; his mother is née Mu. Both of his parents are living. His younger brothers are Gao Song and Gao Yan. He is married to née Shao. He placed 21st in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 132nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Jiang Fu 蔣敷 (registered in Jiangning County, Yingtian Prefecture, under a medical household registration; a medical student in the Imperial Academy of Medicine specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Zongde, first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty, born on the sixth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Jiang Yifu; his grandfather was Jiang Zizhong; his father was Jiang Yansheng (Imperial Physician in the Imperial Academy of Medicine); his mother is née Zhou. His mother is living. His younger brothers are Jiang Chang and Jiang Xu. He is married to née Shi. He placed 31st in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 17th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Min 徐珉 (registered in Kaihua County, Quzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang, under a civilian household registration; a student of the county school specializing in the Book of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Tingyu, second in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-eight, born on the eighteenth day of the eighth month). His great-grandfather was Xu Yuanshi; his grandfather was Xu Yinghe (Assistant Magistrate of Sha County, Fujian); his father is Xu Wenhuan; his mother is née Jiang. Both of his parents are living. His paternal uncle is Xu Wenhui (tribute scholar of the wuwu year [1438]); his elder brother is Xu Kui; his younger brothers are [paternal cousin Xu Xi,] Xu Jin, Xu Ying, and Xu Xiong. He is married to née Wu. He placed 13th in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 57th in the Metropolitan Examination.

朱永寧〔貫直隸徽州府歙縣軍籍，府學生，治《春秋》，字永寧，行四，年三十九，五月初十日生〕。曾祖明甫；祖仲玉；父敬宗；母胡氏；繼母王氏。慈侍下。兄永忠、永和、永祥、永亮、永昌、永明、永壽。娶鮑氏，繼娶鮑氏。應天府鄉試第九十六名，會試第十六名。

translation_en:
Dai Min 戴珉 (registered as a civilian household in Fuliang County 浮梁縣, Raozhou Prefecture 饒州府, Jiangxi 江西; an added student of the Prefectural School specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Tingzhen 廷振; seventh in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-six, born on the eleventh day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Dai Tao 燾; his grandfather was Dai Si'an 嗣安 (posthumously honoured as Assistant Administration Commissioner of Shaanxi 陝西); his paternal elder uncle was Dai Bian 弁 (Administration Vice Commissioner of Huguang 湖廣); his father was Dai Zhen 貞; and his mother is née Zheng 鄭氏. His mother is living. His paternal younger uncles are Dai Bian 昪 (Instructor of Cixi County 慈谿) and Dai Wei 委 (Assistant Instructor of Shuyang County 沭陽); his elder brothers are Dai Rui 瑞 (Principal-grade Secretary in the Ministry of Personnel) and Dai Lin 琳. He is married to née Li 李氏. He ranked fortieth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and sixty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Qi 李玘 (registered as a civilian household in Yiyang County 弋陽縣, Guangxin Prefecture 廣信府, Jiangxi 江西; a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Tingshen 廷紳; twenty-fifth in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-six, born on the fourth day of the sixth month). His great-grandfather was Li Demao 德懋; his grandfather was Li Xingzu 興祖; his father is Li Kui 奎 (Left Case Reviewer of the Court of Judicial Review); his mother was née Zhang 張氏; and his stepmother is née Chen 陳氏. Both parents are living. His elder brother is Li Yuan 𡊮 [?], and his younger brother is Li Lin 璘. He is married to née Yang 楊氏. He ranked fifty-third in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and one hundred twenty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhu Yongning 朱永寧 (registered as a military household in She County 歙縣, Huizhou Prefecture 徽州府, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili 直隸]; a student of the Prefectural School specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Yongning 永寧; fourth in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-nine, born on the tenth day of the fifth month). His great-grandfather was Zhu Mingfu 明甫; his grandfather was Zhu Zhongyu 仲玉; his father was Zhu Jingzong 敬宗; his mother was née Hu 胡氏; and his stepmother is née Wang 王氏. His stepmother is living. His elder brothers are Zhu Yongzhong 永忠, Zhu Yonghe 永和, Zhu Yongxiang 永祥, Zhu Yongliang 永亮, Zhu Yongchang 永昌, Zhu Yongming 永明, and Zhu Yongshou 永壽. He married née Bao 鮑氏 and remarried née Bao 鮑氏. He ranked ninety-sixth in the Yingtian Prefecture 應天府 Provincial Examination and sixteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lu Zan 魯瓚 (registered as a military household in Shaoyang County 邵陽縣, Baoqing Prefecture 寶慶府, Huguang 湖廣; a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Tingqi 廷器; third in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-six, born on the ninth day of the fourth month). His great-grandfather was Lu Yizhong 宜仲; his grandfather was Lu Bao 寶; his father is Lu Ming 銘; and his mother is née Zou 鄒氏. Both parents are living. His elder brothers are Lu Jue 珏 and Lu Li 理; his younger brothers are Lu Lin 璘 and Lu Ji 璣. He is married to née Liu 劉氏. He ranked twenty-seventh in the Huguang Provincial Examination and one hundred thirty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

His great-grandfather was Bochuan 伯川, his grandfather was Jingchu 敬初, his father is Maozheng 茂政, and his mother is née Guo 郭氏. Liu Qing 劉清 [native of Chuzhou 滁州 in the Metropolitan Area (Zhili 直隸), of military registration; a National University Student specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Lianfu 廉夫; fifth in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-two, born on the twentieth day of the first month]. Jiao Dun 焦鈍 (registered in an official household in Ye County 葉縣, Yu Subprefecture 裕州, Nanyang Prefecture 南陽府, Henan 河南; Added Student in the County School; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu 春秋); courtesy name Bingcong 秉聰; first in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-seven, born on the twenty-sixth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Jing 敬 (posthumously honored as Right Administration Commissioner of Jiangxi 江西); his grandfather was Ying 英 (Assistant Magistrate of Pingxiang County 萍鄉縣, posthumously honored as Right Administration Commissioner of Jiangxi); his father is Hong 宏 (serving as Right Vice Minister of Revenue); his mother is née Li 李氏 (invested as Lady). He placed ninth in the Henan Provincial Examination and forty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Cong 王琮 (registered as a commoner in Daxing County 大興縣, Shuntian Prefecture 順天府; Prefectural Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing 易經); courtesy name Liangbi 良璧; first in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-five, born on the seventeenth day of the tenth month). His great-grandfather was Maohua 茂華; his grandfather was Wencheng 文誠; his father is Mengyi 孟宜 (Calendar-maker in the Directorate of Astronomy); his mother is née Zhang 張氏. Both of his parents are living. His younger brother is Yu 璵. He married a woman née Shen 沈氏. He placed fourth in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred eleventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Bendao 李本道 (registered in a military household in Shanhua County 善化縣, Changsha Prefecture 長沙府, Huguang 湖廣; Prefectural Student; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing 書經); courtesy name Zhenglun 正倫; first in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-eight, born on the second day of the second month). His great-grandfather was Tingying 庭英; his grandfather was Deqing 得清 (Registrar of Lin'an Guard 臨安衛, Yunnan 雲南); his father is Yi 義; his mother is née Ding 丁氏. Both of his parents are living. He married a woman née Wang 王氏. He placed thirty-ninth in the Huguang Provincial Examination and one hundred tenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

His great-grandfather was Qin Fu 富, his grandfather was Qin Zhongjie 仲傑, his father is Qin Wen 文, his mother was Lady Shen 沈氏, and his stepmother is Lady Yang 楊氏. His father and stepmother are both living. His younger brothers are Qin Min 敏 and Qin Xiao 斅. He married Lady Liu 劉氏. Shen Huan 沈瓛 (registered in Huating County, Songjiang Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area [Zhili], under civilian household status; Prefectural Student; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals [Chunqiu]; courtesy name Tingyu 廷玉; first in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-four, born on the twenty-fourth day of the first month). His great-grandfather was Shen Yizhen 以禎, his grandfather was Shen Yuangang 原剛, his father is Shen Yonghui 用輝, and his mother is Lady Gao 高氏. Both of his parents are living. He married Lady Zhu 朱氏. He ranked fifth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and seventy-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Qiao Yi 喬毅 (registered in Leping County, Pingding Subprefecture, Taiyuan Prefecture, Shanxi, under military household status; National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Documents [Shujing]; courtesy name Zhihong 志弘; second in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-eight, born on the twenty-fifth day of the seventh month). His great-grandfather was Qiao Yanqing 岩卿, his grandfather was Qiao Binlu 彬魯, his father is Qiao Jian 鑑 (Assistant Magistrate of Tangyin County), and his mother is Lady Li 李氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Qiao Gang 剛, and his younger brother is Qiao Mu 木. He married Lady Wang 王氏. He ranked first in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and forty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

吳淳

曾祖敬　叔〔元陵縣主簿〕　祖訥〔左副都御史致仕〕　祖母張氏〔贈恭人〕　繼祖母張氏〔封恭人〕

punctuated:
孫昱〔貫山東兖州府濟寧州官籍，府學□，治《詩經》，字廷昭，行四，年三十二，五月二十五日生〕。曾祖元成；祖仲義；父永〔前戶部主事〕；母秦氏。慈侍下。兄鼎、英、晟，弟昊。娶劉氏。山東鄉試第十二名，會試第一百四十八名。

吳淳〔貫直隸蘇州府常熟縣官籍，國子生，治《書經》，字厚伯，行一，年三十二，十二月二十日生〕。曾祖敬叔〔沅陵縣主簿〕；祖訥〔左副都御史致仕〕；祖母張氏〔贈恭人〕；繼祖母張氏〔封恭人〕；父欽；母陳氏〔旌表節婦〕。重慶下。娶連氏。應天府鄉試第五十七名，會試第五十一名。

王芳〔貫江西撫州府金谿縣民籍，國子生，治《書經》，字宇直，行四，年四十三，正月二十八日生〕。曾祖謙和；祖仕允；父宗睿；母饒氏。嚴侍下。弟仁、立。娶吳氏。應天府鄉試第三十四名，會試第一百二十八名。

孟祥〔貫山西遼州民籍，國子生，治《春秋》，字廷瑞，行二，年二十七，六月二十九日生〕。曾祖用；祖成；父端〔癸卯貢士〕；母李氏。具慶下。兄吉，弟賢、慶。娶李氏。山西鄉試第三名，會試第一百二十名。
translation_en:
Sun Yu 孫昱 [registered in Jining Subprefecture 濟寧州, Yanzhou Prefecture 兖州府, Shandong 山東, under official household status (guanji); a Prefectural School [student? □], specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Tingzhao 廷昭; fourth in seniority among his brothers; thirty-two sui, born on the twenty-fifth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Sun Yuancheng 元成; his grandfather was Sun Zhongyi 仲義; his father was Sun Yong 永 [former Secretary (zhushi) in the Ministry of Revenue (Hubu)]; his mother is née Qin 秦氏. His mother is living (cishi xia). His elder brothers are Ding 鼎, Ying 英, and Sheng 晟; his younger brother is Hao 昊. He married née Liu 劉氏. He placed twelfth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 148th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wu Chun 吳淳 [registered in Changshu County 常熟縣, Suzhou Prefecture 蘇州府, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili 直隸), under official household status (guanji); a National University Student (guozisheng), specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Houbo 厚伯; first in seniority among his brothers; thirty-two sui, born on the twentieth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Wu Jingshu 敬叔 [Assistant Magistrate (zhubu) of Yuanling County 沅陵縣]; his grandfather is Wu Ne 訥 [retired Left Vice Censor-in-Chief (zuo fudu御史)]; his grandmother was née Zhang 張氏 [posthumously honored as Lady of Respect (gongren)]; his step-grandmother is née Zhang 張氏 [invested as Lady of Respect (gongren)]; his father was Wu Qin 欽; his mother is née Chen 陳氏 [honored with a commemorative arch as a chaste widow (jingbiao jiefu)]. Grandparents and mother are living [chongqing xia; note: though his father was deceased as indicated by his mother's status as a chaste widow, his retired grandfather and step-grandmother were living]. He married née Lian 連氏. He placed fifty-seventh in the Yingtian Prefectural Examination (Provincial Examination) and fifty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Fang 王芳 [registered in Jinxi County 金谿縣, Fuzhou Prefecture 撫州府, Jiangxi 江西, under commoner household status (minji); a National University Student (guozisheng), specializing in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); courtesy name Yuzhi 宇直; fourth in seniority among his brothers; forty-three sui, born on the twenty-eighth day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Wang Qianhe 謙和; his grandfather was Wang Shiyun 仕允; his father is Wang Zongrui 宗睿; his mother was née Rao 饒氏. His father is living (yanshi xia). His younger brothers are Ren 仁 and Li 立. He married née Wu 吳氏. He placed thirty-fourth in the Yingtian Prefectural Examination (Provincial Examination) and 128th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Meng Xiang 孟祥 [registered in Liao Subprefecture 遼州, Shanxi 山西, under commoner household status (minji); a National University Student (guozisheng), specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Tingrui 廷瑞; second in seniority among his brothers; twenty-seven sui, born on the twenty-ninth day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Meng Yong 用; his grandfather was Meng Cheng 成; his father is Meng Duan 端 [Tribute Student / Provincial Graduate (gongshi) of the guimao year (1423)]; his mother is née Li 李氏. Both parents are living (juqing xia). His elder brother is Ji 吉; his younger brothers are Xian 賢 and Qing 慶. He married née Li 李氏. He placed third in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and 120th in the Metropolitan Examination.

貫山東濟南府歷城縣民籍　府學增廣生
治書經字同仁行四年二十七五月二十八日生

貫山東萊州府掖縣軍籍　國子生

曾祖友道　祖居寧　父善　母朱氏

山東鄉試第一名　會試第八十八名
punctuated:
李尚〔貫浙江寧波府慈谿縣，民籍，儒士，治《詩經》，字尚文，行八，年二十六，六月二十一日生〕，曾祖惟益，祖伯顏，父棠〔前沭陽縣教諭〕，母柳氏。具慶下，弟尚高、尚言、尚奇，娶羅氏。浙江鄉試第十五名，會試第十二名。

彭廣〔貫順天府宛平縣富戶籍，江西安福縣人，國子生，治《春秋》，字深博，行三，年四十，閏四月二十七日生〕，曾祖仁端，祖名卿，父學旭，母謝氏。慈侍下，兄深資、深規，娶李氏。順天府鄉試第九十九名，會試第一百二名。

尹旻〔貫山東濟南府歷城縣，民籍，府學增廣生，治《書經》，字同仁，行四，年二十七，五月二十八日生〕，曾祖均壽，祖得名，父宏〔泉州府知府〕，母姚氏。慈侍下，弟昌，娶張氏。山東鄉試第一名，會試第四十八名。

張斐〔貫山東萊州府掖縣，軍籍，國子生，治《詩經》，字文著，行一，年二十六，正月十九日生〕，曾祖友道，祖居寧，父善，母朱氏。具慶下，娶楊氏。山東鄉試第一名，會試第八十八名。
translation_en:
Li Shang 李尚 (registered in Cixi County, Ningbo Prefecture, Zhejiang, under civilian household status; Confucian Scholar (rushi), specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Shangwen, eighth in seniority among his male cousins, aged twenty-six, born on the twenty-first day of the sixth month): his great-grandfather was Li Weiyi, his grandfather was Li Boyan, his father is Li Tang (former Instructor of Shuyang County), and his mother is née Liu. Both parents are living; his younger brothers are Li Shanggao, Li Shangyan, and Li Shangqi, and he is married to née Luo. He placed fifteenth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and twelfth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Peng Guang 彭廣 (registered under wealthy household status in Wanping County, Shuntian Prefecture, originally from Anfu County, Jiangxi; Student of the Directorate of Education (guozisheng), specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Shenbo, third in seniority, aged forty, born on the twenty-seventh day of the intercalary fourth month): his great-grandfather was Peng Renduan, his grandfather was Peng Mingqing, his father was Peng Xuexu, and his mother is née Xie. His mother is living (while his father is deceased); his elder brothers are Peng Shenzi and Peng Shengui, and he is married to née Li. He placed ninety-ninth in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and one hundred and second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yin Min 尹旻 (registered in Licheng County, Jinan Prefecture, Shandong, under civilian household status; Added Student (zengguangsheng) of the Prefectural School, specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Tongren, fourth in seniority, aged twenty-seven, born on the twenty-eighth day of the fifth month): his great-grandfather was Yin Junshou, his grandfather was Yin Deming, his father was Yin Hong (Prefect of Quanzhou Prefecture), and his mother is née Yao. His mother is living (while his father is deceased); his younger brother is Yin Chang, and he is married to née Zhang. He placed first in the Shandong Provincial Examination and forty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Fei 張斐 (registered in Ye County, Laizhou Prefecture, Shandong, under military household status; Student of the Directorate of Education (guozisheng), specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Wenzhu, first in seniority, aged twenty-six, born on the nineteenth day of the first month): his great-grandfather was Zhang Youdao, his grandfather was Zhang Juning, his father is Zhang Shan, and his mother is née Zhu. Both parents are living, and he is married to née Yang. He placed first in the Shandong Provincial Examination and eighty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

===
劉泰
貫江西吉安府安福縣軍籍　富峪衛軍餘
治易經字旹亨行三年二十九閏正月初八日生

曾祖以德　祖彥中　父淵　母唐氏　繼母孫氏

四川鄉試第二十三名　會試第六十一名
punctuated:
王讓〔貫順天府宛平縣富□籍，常州府武進縣人，國子生，治《詩經》，字克讓，行二，年四十，八月初二日生〕。曾祖茂林；祖志中；父肅；母余氏，繼母狄氏。具慶下，弟端，娶朱氏。順天府鄉試第十四名，會試第一百四十九名。

戴昂〔貫順天府懷柔縣民籍，縣學生，治《易經》，字時舉，行一，年三十八，二月初十日生〕。曾祖亨；祖成；父儼〔河南府學教授，致仕〕；母許氏。具慶下，弟時榮，娶鄭氏。順天府鄉試第二十名，會試第九名。

劉泰〔貫江西吉安府安福縣軍籍，富峪衛軍餘，治《易經》，字皆亨，行三，年二十九，閏正月初八日生〕。曾祖憲；祖巖；父洪〔臨清縣學訓導〕；母周氏。具慶下，兄謙、晋，娶潘氏。順天府鄉試第五十六名，會試第一百五名。

黃裳〔貫四川眉州民籍，州學增廣生，治《春秋》，字懋臣，行三，年二十二，十二月十一日生〕。曾祖以德；祖彥中；父淵；母唐氏，繼母孫氏。具慶下，兄本初、本政，娶鄒氏。四川鄉試第二十三名，會試第六十一名。
translation_en:
Wang Rang 王讓: Registered in a wealthy household [富戶?] in Wanping County, Shuntian Prefecture, originally from Wujin County, Changzhou Prefecture; a Student of the Directorate of Education (guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Kerang, second in seniority among his brothers, aged forty, born on the second day of the eighth month. His great-grandfather was Wang Maolin, his grandfather was Wang Zhizhong, his father is Wang Su, his mother was née Yu, and his stepmother is née Di. Both his father and stepmother are living; he has a younger brother named Wang Duan, and is married to née Zhu. He placed 14th in the Shuntian Provincial Examination and 149th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Dai Ang 戴昂: Registered in a civilian household in Huairou County, Shuntian Prefecture; a County Student (xianxuesheng) specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Shiju, first in seniority among his brothers, aged thirty-eight, born on the tenth day of the second month. His great-grandfather was Dai Heng, his grandfather was Dai Cheng, his father is Dai Yan (a retired Instructor of the Confucian School of Henan Prefecture), and his mother is née Xu. Both his parents are living; he has a younger brother named Dai Shirong, and is married to née Zheng. He placed 20th in the Shuntian Provincial Examination and 9th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Tai 劉泰: Registered in a military household in Anfu County, Ji'an Prefecture, Jiangxi, serving as a supernumerary soldier (junyu) in the Fuyu Guard; specializing in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Jieheng, third in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-nine, born on the eighth day of the intercalary first month. His great-grandfather was Liu Xian, his grandfather was Liu Yan, his father is Liu Hong (an Assistant Instructor of the Confucian School of Linqing County), and his mother is née Zhou. Both his parents are living; he has elder brothers named Liu Qian and Liu Jin, and is married to née Pan. He placed 56th in the Shuntian Provincial Examination and 105th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Huang Shang 黃裳: Registered in a civilian household in Meizhou, Sichuan; an Expectant Student of the Subprefectural School (zhouxue zengguangsheng) specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Maochen, third in seniority among his brothers, aged twenty-two, born on the eleventh day of the twelfth month. His great-grandfather was Huang Yide, his grandfather was Huang Yanzhong, his father is Huang Yuan, his mother was née Tang, and his stepmother is née Sun. Both his father and stepmother are living; he has elder brothers named Huang Benchu and Huang Benzheng, and is married to née Zou. He placed 23rd in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 61st in the Metropolitan Examination.

洪常〔貫浙江寧波府鄞縣，民籍，國子生。治《易經》，字子經，行一，年三十五，六月二十四日生〕。曾祖和卿，祖源，父初，母趙氏。具慶下，娶張氏。浙江鄉試第二十五名，會試第六十二名。

葉祿〔貫江西廣信府貴溪縣，軍籍，縣學生。治《春秋》，字祿元，行三十二，年三十二，十月十六日生〕。曾祖茂遠，祖谷義，父時兆，母樊氏。具慶下，兄祿榮、祿全、祿昌，弟祿愷，娶王氏。江西鄉試第五十四名，會試第一百三十七名。

李讚〔貫直隸淮安府山陽縣，民籍，國子生。治《易經》，字公美，行五，年四十三，十一月十六日生〕。曾祖懋林，祖義琦，父敬中，母韓氏。永感下，兄讓、誼、謙、謐，弟諄、訓，娶王氏。應天府鄉試第九十四名，會試第十三名。

閉悌〔貫廣西南寧府橫州，軍籍，國子生。治《詩經》，字孔仁，行一，年三十二，三月二十三日生〕。曾祖仲寧，祖思暢，父禎〔福建惠安縣知縣〕，母張氏。具慶下，弟悅、恂、懌，娶樂氏。廣西鄉試第十一名，會試第三十七名。
translation_en:
Hong Chang 洪常 [registered in Yin County, Ningbo Prefecture, Zhejiang, of civilian status, a National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Zijing; first in his generation; age thirty-five, born on the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Hong Heqing, his grandfather was Hong Yuan, his father is Hong Chu, and his mother is née Zhao. Both parents are living; he married née Zhang. He placed twenty-fifth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and sixty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ye Lu 葉祿 [registered in Guixi County, Guangxin Prefecture, Jiangxi, of military status, a County School Student; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Luyuan; thirty-second in his generation; age thirty-two, born on the sixteenth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Ye Maoyuan, his grandfather was Ye Guyi, his father is Ye Shizhao, and his mother is née Fan. Both parents are living; he has elder brothers Ye Lurong, Ye Luquan, and Ye Luchang, and a younger brother Ye Lukai; he married née Wang. He placed fifty-fourth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and one hundred thirty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Zan 李讚 [registered in Shanyang County, Huai'an Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Region (Zhili), of civilian status, a National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Gongmei; fifth in his generation; age forty-three, born on the sixteenth day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Li Maolin, his grandfather was Li Yiqi, his father was Li Jingzhong, and his mother was née Han. Both parents are deceased; he has elder brothers Li Rang, Li Yi, Li Qian, and Li Mi, and younger brothers Li Zhun and Li Xun; he married née Wang. He placed ninety-fourth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and thirteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Bi Ti 閉悌 [registered in Hengzhou, Nanning Prefecture, Guangxi, of military status, a National University Student; specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Kongren; first in his generation; age thirty-two, born on the twenty-third day of the third month]. His great-grandfather was Bi Zhongning, his grandfather was Bi Sichang, his father is Bi Zhen [District Magistrate of Hui'an County, Fujian], and his mother is née Zhang. Both parents are living; he has younger brothers Bi Yue, Bi Xun, and Bi Yi; he married née Yue. He placed eleventh in the Guangxi Provincial Examination and thirty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

punctuated:
李寬〔貫直隸鳳陽府盱眙縣人，四川叙南衛軍，治《易經》，字宗裕，行一，年二十九，六月十六日生〕。曾祖遇春；祖成；父暉；前母周氏；母田氏。慈侍下。娶陳氏。四川鄉試第四十三名，會試第一百二十二名。

張鍪〔貫直隸松江府華亭縣民籍，縣學增廣生，治《書經》，字廷器，行一，年二十六，九月初三日生〕。曾祖本中；祖原璧；父璚〔任紀善〕；母吳氏。重慶下。弟鑒、鑾。娶衛氏。應天府鄉試第六十七名，會試第八十名。

王正〔貫山西平陽府解州夏縣民籍，縣學增廣生，治《書經》，字嗣宗，行三，年二十九，十月初十日生〕。曾祖仲文〔河南脩武縣知縣〕；祖翰〔廣東廉州府學教授〕；父礪〔遼府長史〕；嫡母李氏；母相氏。具慶下。兄福、賢；弟聰。娶朱氏。山西鄉試第七名，會試第一百四十七名。

王璧〔貫四川重慶府合州儒籍，州學生，治《詩經》，字廷玉，行一，年三十，十月二十一日生〕。曾祖斌；祖佐；父汝義；母周氏。重慶下。弟珪、瓚、璋、瓊。娶楊氏。四川鄉試第十名，會試第二十九名。
translation_en:
Li Kuan 李寬 [Originally from Xuyi County, Fengyang Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili), serving as a soldier in the Xunan Guard in Sichuan; specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); style name Zongyu; seniority first; age twenty-nine, born on the sixteenth day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Li Yuchun; his grandfather was Li Cheng; his father was Li Hui; his father's former wife was née Zhou; and his mother is née Tian. His mother is living while his father is deceased (cishi xia). He married a woman née Chen. He placed forty-third in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and one hundred twenty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Mou 張鍪 [Registered in a civilian household of Huating County, Songjiang Prefecture, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); an added student (zengguang sheng) at the county school; specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); style name Tingqi; seniority first; age twenty-six, born on the third day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhang Benzhong; his grandfather is Zhang Yuanbi; his father is Zhang Qiong [serving as Attendant Tutor in a Princely Establishment (Jishan)]; and his mother is née Wu. Both his parents and grandparents are living (chongqing xia). His younger brothers are Zhang Jian and Zhang Luan. He married a woman née Wei. He placed sixty-seventh in the Yingtian Prefectural (Provincial) Examination and eightieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Zheng 王正 [Registered in a civilian household of Xia County, Xiezhou Department, Pingyang Prefecture, Shanxi; an added student at the county school; specialized in the Classic of Documents (Shujing); style name Sizong; seniority third; age twenty-nine, born on the tenth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Wang Zhongwen [District Magistrate (Zhixian) of Xiuwu County, Henan]; his grandfather was Wang Han [Instructor (Jiaoshou) in the Prefectural School of Lianzhou Prefecture, Guangdong]; his father is Wang Li [Administrator (Zhangshi) in the Princely Establishment of Liao]; his legal mother is née Li; and his birth mother is née Xiang. Both his parents are living (juqing xia). His elder brothers are Wang Fu and Wang Xian; his younger brother is Wang Cong. He married a woman née Zhu. He placed seventh in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and one hundred forty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Bi 王璧 [Registered in a Confucian scholar household of Hezhou Department, Chongqing Prefecture, Sichuan; a department school student (zhou xuesheng); specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); style name Tingyu; seniority first; age thirty, born on the twenty-first day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Wang Bin; his grandfather is Wang Zuo; his father is Wang Ruyi; and his mother is née Zhou. Both his parents and grandparents are living (chongqing xia). His younger brothers are Wang Gui, Wang Zan, Wang Zhang, and Wang Qiong. He married a woman née Yang. He placed tenth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and twenty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

鄭文康〔貫直隸蘇州府崑山縣，民籍，縣學增廣生，治《詩經》，字時乂，行二，年三十七，二月二十四日生〕。曾祖彥實；祖以敬；伯庚〔安仁縣學教諭〕；父壬，母盧氏。具慶下。兄羽，弟友光。娶董氏。應天府鄉試第二十三名，會試第二十七名。

江眞〔貫直隸徽州府歙縣，民籍，國子生，治《禮記》，字士元，行三，年三十五，七月二十二日生〕。曾祖仲卿；祖子仁〔永淳縣知縣〕；父彥才，母吳氏。慈侍下。兄士敏、士性，弟士禧。娶程氏。應天府鄉試第十九名，會試第一百十八名。

華顯〔貫順天府宛平縣，匠籍，府學生，治《詩經》，字用明，行一，年三十一，八月初九日生〕。曾祖君瑞；祖士清；父昱，母樊氏。具慶下。娶徐氏。順天府鄉試第五十二名，會試第一百二十四名。

translation_en:
Zheng Wenkang 鄭文康 [registered in Kunshan County 崑山縣, Suzhou Prefecture 蘇州府, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili 直隸), under civilian household registration; an added student (zengguang sheng) of the county school, specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Shiyi 時乂; second in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-seven, born on the twenty-fourth day of the second month]. His great-grandfather was Zheng Yanshi 彥實; his grandfather was Zheng Yijing 以敬; his paternal elder uncle was Zheng Geng 庚 [Instructor (jiaoyu) of the Anren County 安仁縣 School]; his father is Zheng Ren 壬, and his mother is née Lu 盧氏. Both of his parents are living. His elder brother is Zheng Yu 羽, and his younger brother is Zheng Youguang 友光. He married née Dong 董氏. He placed twenty-third in the Yingtian Prefectural 應天府 Provincial Examination and twenty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Jiang Zhen 江眞 [registered in She County 歙縣, Huizhou Prefecture 徽州府, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili 直隸), under civilian household registration; a Directorate student (guozisheng), specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Shiyuan 士元; third in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-five, born on the twenty-second day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Jiang Zhongqing 仲卿; his grandfather was Jiang Ziren 子仁 [Magistrate (zhixian) of Yongchun County 永淳縣]; his father was Jiang Yancai 彥才, and his mother is née Wu 吳氏. His mother is living. His elder brothers are Jiang Shimin 士敏 and Jiang Shixing 士性, and his younger brother is Jiang Shixi 士禧. He married née Cheng 程氏. He placed nineteenth in the Yingtian Prefectural 應天府 Provincial Examination and one hundred and eighteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Hua Xian 華顯 [registered in Wanping County 宛平縣, Shuntian Prefecture 順天府, under artisan household registration; a student of the prefectural school, specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Yongming 用明; first in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-one, born on the ninth day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Hua Junrui 君瑞; his grandfather was Hua Shiqing 士清; his father is Hua Yu 昱, and his mother is née Fan 樊氏. Both of his parents are living. He married née Xu 徐氏. He placed fifty-second in the Shuntian Prefectural 順天府 Provincial Examination and one hundred and twenty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Sheng Lun 盛綸 [registered in Huating County 華亭縣, Songjiang Prefecture 松江府, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili 直隸), under civilian household registration; a Directorate student (guozisheng), specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Yiduan 以端; second in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-two, born on the twenty-second day of the seventh month]. His great-grandfather was Sheng Hengji 亨吉; his grandfather is Sheng Deqian 德謙; his father is Sheng Liwen 禮聞, and his mother is née Hou 侯氏. Both his parents and grandparents are living. His elder brother is Sheng Jing 經, and his younger brothers are Sheng Chun 純 and Sheng Yi 繹. He married née Jiang 蔣氏, and remarried née Chen 陳氏. He placed thirty-first in the Yingtian Prefectural 應天府 Provincial Examination and one hundred and forty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Tang Rang 唐瀼 [registered as a commoner in Houguan County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Fujian; a student of the county school; specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); courtesy name Yuanjie; sixth in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-six, born on the twenty-third day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Tang Qing; his grandfather was Tang Zhang; his father was Tang Jian; his mother was née Chen, and his stepmother was née Lin. Both his father and stepmother are living. His younger brothers are Tang Zhou, Tang Chao, Tang Tan, and Tang Ti. He is betrothed to a woman née Zheng. He placed fourth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and twenty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Yu 王育 [registered as a commoner in Tai'an Subprefecture, Jinan Prefecture, Shandong; a student of the subprefectural school; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Yangmin; third in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-one, born on the nineteenth day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Wang Youliang; his grandfather was Wang Zhong; his father is Wang Gui [Instructor (jiaoyu) of Xia County, Shanxi]; his mother was née Cao. His father is living. His elder brothers are Wang Mu [Assistant Instructor (xundao) of Kaicheng County, Shaanxi] and Wang Zi. He married a woman née Li. He placed eleventh in the Shandong Provincial Examination and one hundred forty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shen Xiang 沈祥 [registered as a commoner in Kunshan County, Suzhou Prefecture, Zhili; an expectant student (zengguang sheng) of the county school; specialized in the Classic of History (Shujing); courtesy name Yingzhen; first in seniority among his brothers; aged thirty-six, born on the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month]. His great-grandfather was Shen Zifu; his grandfather was Shen Xian; his father is Shen Ming; his mother is née Du. Both his parents are living. His younger brothers are Shen Xi and Shen Qi. He married a woman née Qu, and remarried a woman née Wang. He placed seventy-ninth in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and one hundred first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Kui 張奎 [registered under a military household in Gushi County, Guang Subprefecture, Runing Prefecture, Henan; a student of the prefectural school; specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Wenming; first in seniority among his brothers; aged twenty-nine, born on the ninth day of the first month]. His great-grandfather was Zhang Rong; his grandfather was Zhang Taixuan; his father is Zhang Hao; his mother was née Mao, and his stepmother is née Cheng. Both his father and stepmother are living. His younger brothers are Zhang Ben, Zhang Antong, Zhang Xihuang, and Zhang Ximin. He married a woman née Wang. He placed fifth in the Henan Provincial Examination and sixty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Xie Ju 謝琚 [registered in a military household in Huai'an County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Fujian; a County School Student specializing in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Zhongyu, second in his generation; age twenty-five, born on the twenty-ninth day of the eighth month]. His great-grandfather was Xie Shuping, his grandfather was Xie De'an, his father is Xie Ming, and his mother is née Long. Both his parents are living. His younger brothers are Xie Cong, Xie Xuan, and Xie Jin. He is unmarried. He placed fifth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and thirty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhou Jun 周駿 [registered in a wealthy household in Daxing County, Shuntian Prefecture, originally from Huating County, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); a Directorate Student (guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Shiliang, second in his generation; age twenty-nine, born on the twenty-fourth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Zhou Daoxian, his grandfather was Zhou Guiyi, his father is Zhou Yanji, his principal mother is née Huang, and his birth mother is née Gu. Both his parents are living. His elder brother is Zhou Lin. He married née Sun and was subsequently betrothed to née Yang. He placed thirty-ninth in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and forty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Pan Rong 潘榮 [registered in a civilian household in Longxi County, Zhangzhou Prefecture, Fujian; a Prefectural School Student specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Zunyong, second in his generation; age thirty, born on the sixth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Pan Weiheng, his grandfather was Pan Congzhou, his father is Pan Qianyou, and his mother is née Chen. Both his parents are living. His elder brother is Pan Zunyang, and his younger brother is Pan Zunyi. He is married to née Lin. He placed twenty-sixth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and ninety-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Xi 王璽 [registered in a civilian household in Hezhou, Southern Metropolitan Area (Zhili); an Added Student (zengguangsheng) of the Subprefectural School of Anzhou, Northern Metropolitan Area (Zhili), specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Tingyong, third in his generation; age thirty, born on the nineteenth day of the fourth month]. His great-grandfather was Wang Yongfu, his grandfather was Wang Zhongwen [invested with the title of Secretary of a Bureau in the Ministry of Revenue], his father is Wang Hao [Vice Director of a Bureau in the Ministry of Revenue], and his mother is née Tao [invested with the title of Mistress of Peace (anren)]. Both his parents are living. His elder brothers are Wang Qi and Wang Xuan, and his younger brothers are Wang Jing, Wang Yu, Wang Min, and Wang Cong. He is married to née Jia. He placed eighteenth in the Shuntian Prefectural Provincial Examination and fifty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Huo Rong 霍榮 [registered as a commoner of Zhouzhi County 盩厔縣, Xi'an Prefecture 西安府, Shaanxi; National University Student (guozi sheng); specialized in the Record of Rites (Liji); courtesy name Wenhua 文華; third in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-nine, born on the twenty-sixth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Mengxian 孟賢, his grandfather was Siyi 思義, his father is Bin 彬, and his mother is née Peng 彭氏. Both parents are living; he has elder brothers Hai 海 and Zhou 洲, and younger brothers Tan 潭 and Yan 演; he married née Zhang 張氏. He placed 26th in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and 98th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhou Xiang 周翔 [registered as a commoner of Cixi County 慈溪縣, Ningbo Prefecture 寧波府, Zhejiang; National University Student (guozi sheng); specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Pengju 鵬舉; twenty-fourth in seniority among brothers and cousins; aged forty, born on the nineteenth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Yanying 彥英, his grandfather was Juren 舉仁, his father is Zongquan 宗惓, and his mother is née Wang 王氏. Both parents are living; he has an elder brother Ao 翱 and a younger brother Xu 珝; he married née Xu 徐氏. He placed 85th in the Yingtian Prefectural Provincial Examination and 116th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Ji 劉濟 [registered as a commoner of Poyang County 鄱陽縣, Raozhou Prefecture 饒州府, Jiangxi; Prefectural Confucian School Student (fuxue sheng); specialized in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); courtesy name Shiyong 時用; first in seniority among brothers; aged twenty-nine, born on the sixth day of the tenth month]. His great-grandfather was Gucai 谷才, his grandfather was Zizai 子載, his father is Lanting 蘭亭, and his mother is née Cheng 程氏. Both parents are living; he has a younger brother Hui 匯; he married née Shan 山氏. He placed 14th in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 49th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Pin 王玭 [registered as a commoner of Nanjing County 南靖縣, Zhangzhou Prefecture 漳州府, Fujian; County Confucian School Student (xianxue sheng); specialized in the Classic of Changes (Yijing); courtesy name Hongzhang 弘章; fifth in seniority among brothers; aged thirty-two, born on the sixteenth day of the intercalary fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Xiande 顯德, his grandfather was Baomin 保民, his father is Xingbi 興弼, and his mother is née Hu 胡氏. Both parents are living; he has elder brothers Hongliang 弘亮, Hongyao 弘耀, Hongyun 弘蘊, and Hongzhong 弘中, and younger brothers Hongzheng 弘政, Honglong 弘隆, and Hongshu 弘舒; he married née Cai 蔡氏. translation_en:
Huang Fu 黃紱 [registered in a military household in Pingyue Guard under the Guizhou Regional Military Commission; a military student of the Guard School specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); style name Yongzhang; second in seniority among his brothers; twenty-six sui, born on the first day of the ninth month]. His great-grandfather was Yu 豫, his grandfather was Xiu 秀, his father is Zhong 中, and his mother is née Zhang 張. Both of his parents are living. He has an elder brother, Ji 吉, and a younger brother, Shou 綬, and he is unmarried. He placed fifth in the Yunnan Provincial Examination and thirty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ren Zi 任孜 [registered in a civilian household in Changzhou County, Suzhou Prefecture, in the Metropolitan Area (Zhili); a student of the Directorate of Education (Guozisheng) specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); style name Maoshan; third in seniority among his brothers; twenty-eight sui, born on the sixth day of the fifth month]. His great-grandfather was Shiyuan 士原, his grandfather was Wenzhong 文中, his father was Zhi 志, and his mother is née Lu 陸. His mother is living. He has elder brothers Zheng 政 and Min 敏, and he is married to née Zhou 周. He placed fifty-fifth in the Yingtian Prefectural Examination and eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Guo An 郭安 [registered in a civilian household in Xiangcheng County, Xuzhou Subprefecture, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan; an added student (zengguangsheng) of the County School specializing in the Classic of History (Shujing); style name Bangning; first in seniority; twenty-four sui, born on the second day of the eleventh month]. His great-grandfather was Can 參, his grandfather was Shu 恕, his father was Xi 熈, and his mother is née Fan 范. His mother is living, and he is married to née Liu 劉. He placed first in the Henan Provincial Examination and 139th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lü Duo 呂鐸 [registered in a military household in Dehua County, Jiujiang Prefecture, Jiangxi; a student of the Directorate of Education (Guozisheng) specializing in the Classic of Poetry (Shijing); style name Wenzhen; second in seniority among his brothers; twenty-eight sui, born on the twenty-eighth day of the twelfth month]. His great-grandfather was Shike 時可, his grandfather was Shi'an 世安, his father is Fuxian 復先, and his mother is née Gong 龔. Both of his parents are living. He has an elder brother, Yong 鏞, and younger brothers Kai 鎧, Qi 錡, Yu 鈓, Jian 鐧, Xuan 鉉, and Yue 鉞. He married née Yin 殷, and remarried née Qing 慶. He placed fortieth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and fifteenth in the Metropolitan Examination.
